newsitem.title: USA: Morgan on British Petroleum, Sun.
newsitem.headline: Morgan on British Petroleum, Sun.

text.p: Morgan Stanley analyst Doug Terreson said he downgraded British Petroleum Co Plc on a price basis only.
"I still love the story over the long-term," said the analyst, who has been a long-time bull on the company and earlier cut his rating to neutral from outperform.
British Petroleum shares fell 1-1/4 to 117-3/4. Terreson said he has been recommending purchase of the stock since it traded at 42.

As for Sun Co Inc, Terreson said he downgraded the stock to neutral from outperform on expectations he "overestimated returns likely generated in some core business, especially refining. I think the cost reduction previously anticipated is less likely to occur."
The analyst said he cut his share earnings estimate to a range of $2.25-2.50 from $2.75-3.00 for "the 1997, 1998 timeframe."
Terreson also cuts his 12-month price to 28 from "30ish."
